# AALIE Oracle Dataset — Reporte generado automáticamente

**80 oracle cases · 80/80 assertion pass · generated by `generate_oracle_report.py`**

## Resumen

The dataset contains 80 oracle cases. All cases execute without assertion errors under their declared expectation kind. Strict mathematical agreement is achieved in 59 strict_math cases. 8 cases validate expected unsupported behavior. 7 cases characterize known engine limitations, including recursive local-work extraction, missing Euclid modulo support, WHILE variable-factor reasoning, and compound-loop diagnostics. 6 export-oriented cases currently validate metadata generation but remain pending for full cross-format export-contract validation.

| **Total** | **80** | **74** | **6** | **0** |
